name: Neon glow
summary: Light as a line of coloured gas, with a soft halo that spills onto the dark ground around it.
how: Draw the tube as a line of 2 to 6mm in one saturated colour; use no more than 2 colours in one sign.
Add a halo of 10 to 40px at 30% to 60% opacity in the same hue.
Set the sign on a ground darker than 10% lightness, so that the halo shows.
Keep a bright, near-white core inside the line.

origin.note: Georges Claude shows his neon tube at the Paris Motor Show in 1910, and a Paris hairdresser installs a neon sign in 1912.

adoptions.via: Venturi, Scott Brown and Izenour study the neon signs of the Las Vegas Strip in Learning from Las Vegas.
Ridley Scott fills the wet night streets of Blade Runner with neon signs.
Web designers fake neon with layered text-shadow and box-shadow glows once browsers support CSS3.
